name: Swordfish
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free protein that's well-tolerated on SIBO diets. Choose fresh or frozen without marinades or seasonings that may contain FODMAPs.
preparationTips: Grill, bake, or pan-sear with FODMAP-friendly herbs like basil or oregano
Avoid pre-marinated varieties that may contain garlic or onion
Season with lemon juice, olive oil, and low-FODMAP spices
Cook to internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) for food safety
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in selenium and vitamin B12
Good source of omega-3 fatty acids
